subject: Re: Pricing & Commitment options — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: James Park <james@scoutlabs.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: pricing + committed use options

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team liked the latency profile and the KV caching examples. We wanted to follow up on pricing so we can validate against our budget. High-level here:
- Expected peak: ~75M tokens/month initially, ramping to ~150M over 6 months.
- Target $/1M tokens: ideally in the $25–$35 range to make the economics work for our product.
- Budget range: we can do $2k–$5k/month initially, with an expectation to increase as usage ramps.

Can you outline what startup discounts / committed-use tiers would look like for those volumes? Also curious about multi-year incentives and how overage pricing would work if we under/over-consume against a commitment.

Nina (cc) is our ops lead — she will own procurement.

Thanks,
James Park
Head of Platform, ScoutLabs

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james@scoutlabs.ai>
Cc: Nina Chen <nina@scoutlabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing + committed use options

James — great to hear the team liked the demo. Quick recap and three options we can run with based on the numbers you shared:

Recap of your ask:
- Current expected: 75M tokens/mo, ramp to ~150M in 6 months
- Target unit economics: $25–$35 / 1M tokens
- Preference: startup-friendly pricing + ability to move to committed discounts as you scale

Options (ballpark, final pricing will go on a formal quote):
1) Startup Program (recommended initial path)
   - 50% off list hosted rates for 12 months, applied to first 100M tokens/month cap.
   - Overages billed at 75% of list (i.e., additional usage beyond cap gets discounted rate).
   - Eligibility needs a short application + exec email (I can sponsor).

2) 12-month Committed Use (best for predictable unit cost)
   - Commit to X tokens/month (we typically size at 50–100M) for 12 months.
   - ~40% discount vs list for committed volume. Overage billed at committed rate + small premium.
   - Quarterly true-up allowed for one tier change per year.

3) Multi-year (24-month) + bigger commitment
   - Combine a 12–20% additional discount on top of committed use for 2-year deals.
   - Can include onboarding credits and extended support SLA.

For your numbers, if we apply the startup program your effective $/1M would land in the $20–$40 range depending on model mix and sequence length. Committed-use for 75M/mo would put you near the lower end of your target once we finalize model profile and quantization options.

Next steps I suggest:
- I will draft an SOW + pricing worksheet for ScoutLabs (attached).
- If you want startup program, confirm and I will loop in Marissa to approve the discount sponsorship.
- If you prefer committed use, tell me the comfortable commit level (50M vs 75M vs 100M) and I’ll get a formal quote.

Attaching: ScoutLabs_SOW_draft.pdf and pricing_worksheet.xlsx — these include sample tier math and overage rules.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Nina Chen <nina@scoutlabs.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <james@scoutlabs.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing + committed use options

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications from procurement side before we move forward:
- Do committed-use discounts apply across model families (e.g., gen vs embeddings) or are they per-model?
- How are monthly true-ups handled if our usage spikes for a short period?
- Would you be able to provide an example quote for a 12-month 75M tokens/month commit (and a 100M tier for comparison)?

If startup sponsorship is the fastest path, we're open to that to buy runway while we finalize commitments.

Best,
Nina Chen
Head of Ops, ScoutLabs

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Nina Chen <nina@scoutlabs.ai>, James Park <james@scoutlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing + committed use options

Nina — answers inline: 
- Committed discounts are applied at the account level and can be scoped per model family in the contract. We can structure the SOW to treat gen and embeddings separately if you prefer different economics.
- Short spikes: monthly true-up with one free spike tolerance (we usually set a 15% headroom). Sustained overages move to overage pricing as defined in the SOW.
- I'll attach a sample quote for 75M and 100M tiers in the pricing worksheet (see attached).

Marissa — looping you in to approve startup sponsorship (50% off list for 12 months up to 100M/mo) so we can get ScoutLabs on a short runway while they finalize a commit. If approved I will issue the startup offer and follow with a DocuSign quote.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing + committed use options

Aditya — approved. Sponsor the ScoutLabs startup offer: 50% off hosted list for 12 months, cap at 100M tokens/month. Include a note that overages billed at 75% of list and that we require a 14-day notice if they intend to convert to a committed-use contract earlier.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
